scenes.title: Level 7: More chords
scenes.subtitle: 7ths, minors and colors
lines: This level adds 7th chords, minor tones and color chords.
You'll play E7, A7, D7, D minor and Sus shapes — and finally get that friendly F.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll play 7th chords like E7, A7 and D7, and sad-sounding D minor.
You'll use B7 and G7 to create tension and resolution, and add color with Sus and add9 chords.
You'll also play Fmaj7 and a simple melody from Scarborough Fair.
Let's explore these five chords: E7, A7, D7, Dm and B7, each with a clear, ringing sound that adds depth to your playing.

scenes.heading: Songs you'll play
lines: This level adds Scarborough Fair, a traditional song that uses the chords you've learned to bring its melody to life.
Let's start with 7th chords — E7, A7 and D7.
Play them slowly, and you'll feel their voice.
